status: proposed configuration, not an executable training launch
initialization: independent random student weights; no Supertonic weights or outputs
teacher: original frozen AudioVAE2 encoder and decoder in FP32

pilot.inference_benchmarks: CPU only, one thread, Apple, Intel and AMD

preflight.implemented_scope: fixed-batch reconstruction only; corpus and GAN training remain separate work
preflight.reference_contract: 16 kHz reference supervises only matching frequencies up to 8 kHz

optimizer_comparison.status: research design; hybrid optimizer not yet implemented or run
optimizer_comparison.candidate: simultaneous Muon for 20 hidden expand/project matrices; AdamW for all other student parameters
optimizer_comparison.discriminator: AdamW in both arms once adversarial training is implemented
optimizer_comparison.criterion: held-out quality per elapsed H100 hour, including optimizer overhead
optimizer_comparison.environment: separate pinned environment with native 2D Muon; existing PyTorch 2.8 has no native Muon

data_policy.reason: GigaSpeech audio access terms restrict use to noncommercial research and education
data_policy.split_policy: speaker and source grouping; exclude all existing evaluation clips

launch_gate: Measure complete step time, memory, quality and I/O in preflight before choosing a sustained training budget
